added_failures_note: total capped at 5: the reviewed run added 2 failing test(s) not retired by name (tests/ids/test_candidates.py::test_every_returned_path_is_a_graph_node_id, tests/ids/test_candidates.py::test_hits_from_several_ids_merge_by_score_without_duplicating_a_path)

findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest records its negative-control log (negative-control-dedup.log, 2 intentional failures) as the after_suite arm, with the same command as baseline_suite, so a reader's added-failure derivation counts those 2 mutation failures as failures the change added and caps the review total; the head-arm suite (tests/ids, 405 passed EXIT=0) is recorded only under tests, and the negative-control failures are not retired by full ::-id, so repairing after_suite to name the head-arm suite (or naming both ids) removes the spurious cap.

follow-on: the assertion {cand.hit.path for cand in candidates} <= node_ids compares the returned paths against the same string literals the test passes both as the fake hits and as node_ids, so it cannot fail if production code synthesised a path; the independent guard is the parent_documentation read-back at tests/ids/test_candidates.py:117.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base ce47cc8b; the single commit e7d200ca adds candidates.py (188 lines), removes the cluster expansion and the ClusterSearcher load in gather_shared_context and re-points gather_ids_context at retrieve_candidates in mapping.py, and adds test_candidates.py (236 lines) and the fragment; mapping.py no longer imports ClusterSearcher, hybrid_dd_search's signature is unchanged, and gather_ids_context keeps its return keys.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/ids and the four bullets; tests/ids/test_candidates.py carries one test per bullet — node id read from a fake graph (:87-117), score merge without a duplicate path and unscoped-empty-list (:120-174), one encoder batch (:177-193), gather_ids_context via retrieve_candidates plus no ClusterSearcher import (:196-236); the manifest records the tests/ids gate as 405 passed, 5 skipped EXIT=0 and I reproduced tests/ids/test_candidates.py at head (6 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a deterministic, LLM-free DD shortlist builder in imas_codex/ids/candidates.py exposing retrieve_candidates(sources, ids_by_source, *, gc, k, dd_version) -> dict[str, list[Candidate]]; read at imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:66-129, it embeds each source once, searches one arm per routed IDS through hybrid_dd_search, merges by score and deduplicates on path, and Candidate (imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:43-55) composes the returned SearchHit with arms and parent_documentation, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the tests/ids gate command and its 405 passed result, test_logs, negative_control_log naming negative-control-dedup.log (last line EXIT=1) and a baseline_suite/after_suite pair whose after_suite log_path is that same negative-control log rather than a head-arm suite (FINDING at manifest.md:16).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/ids/candidates.py, imas_codex/ids/mapping.py, tests/ids/test_candidates.py and the evidence fragment; git show --stat e7d200ca lists exactly those four paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control (drop the path deduplication in the arm merge) reddens the merge test exactly (2 failed, 4 passed, EXIT=1, negative-control-dedup.log), so tests/ids/test_candidates.py:149-154 guards the dedup, but the node-id test's subset assertion at tests/ids/test_candidates.py:115 has both sides supplied by the test and no test covers a source absent from ids_by_source.
justifications.evidence: tests/ids carries a test for each done-when bullet and the manifest records 405 passed, 5 skipped EXIT=0, which I reproduced for the node's own module at head e7d200ca (6 passed, EXIT=0, review-gate.log); the manifest's after_suite arm is the negative-control log, so the recorded head-arm suite is the node's tests line rather than a separate after_suite measurement.
justifications.fit: the added names describe mechanism (retrieve_candidates, Candidate, DEFAULT_K, UNSCOPED_ARM, _merge_arms, _fetch_parent_documentation) with no version, plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no attribution, and the frozen slots dataclass matches the surrounding style at imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:43-63.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:66-129 implements retrieve_candidates exactly as §4 names it, and imas_codex/ids/mapping.py:767 builds source_candidates through it while mapping.py no longer references ClusterSearcher.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing search owner rather than forking it (hybrid_dd_search reused with ids_filter, imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:146-153, and Candidate composes SearchHit rather than copying its fields), but the parent-documentation lookup at imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:165-180 is a fresh query beside the repository's existing parent-documentation reads (imas_codex/graph/dd_enrichment.py:666, imas_codex/graph/dd_workers.py:863), which use coalesce(description, documentation) where it reads documentation alone.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat e7d200ca touches only the four paths the manifest declares and every mapping.py hunk is a consequence of moving the shortlist into candidates.py, though §4's node write paths name three of those files and not the evidence fragment.
